text: The induction principle for S¹ states: to prove P(x) for all x:S¹, you need:
choices: P(base) and a path over loop connecting P(base) to itself
explanation: S¹-ind: given P:S¹→U, you need d_base:P(base) and d_loop:transport^P(loop, d_base) = d_base (a path over loop). This is stronger than the recursion principle.
